name: r10-i-e3-tmaconv-gate
author: solx-loop
description: H43 STEP 1. A conv fed by one 3-D TMA box per 16-channel stage (out-of-image rows and columns zero-filled by the TMA unit), with 49 taps in registers and 2x7 (64,96) or 4x4 (32,128) register patches, writes fp16 d straight into the SW128 B layout and the LN statistics into smem. It runs conv-only 64,96 in 233 us rented (G r7 conv side 472; FMA bound 102) and 32,128 in 56 us. That is below the 250 us STEP 2 threshold but above the 180 us success line.
